instrument.name: Timed Up and Down Stairs
instrument.construct: functional stair mobility combining ascent, turning and descent

rmd.standard_description: The commonly described TUDS protocol uses a timed ascent and descent of a stair flight. Rawafid records the exact staircase geometry and administration variant rather than assuming all staircases are equivalent.

scoring.primary_score: total timed ascent-turn-descent seconds under a declared protocol

rights.basis: RMD Cost=Free is not treated as a reproduction license. Rawafid publishes an original timing, staircase-identity and safety/QC sheet with independently worded procedural cues; it does not reproduce a third-party score form, script, manual layout or copyrighted instructional text.
